summary: Reviewed two owner-uploaded Kyna English PDF lessons: 'What I eat in a day' Speaking Practice (5 pages, 20 discussion prompts and My N.A.M.E warmup) and 'Would you like some soup? Part 1' Beginner 1A (14 pages). Produced verified UTF-8 Vietnamese-A1/A2 markdown files /mnt/data/kyna_what_i_eat_in_a_day_study_notes.md (244 lines; all 20 original questions with sample answers, sentence frames, four dialogs, speech, practice) and /mnt/data/kyna_would_you_like_some_soup_part1_study_notes.md (238 lines; page mappings, illustrated exercise solutions pages 3-5 and 8-9, offers, countability, a/an/some/any, spoken examples). Explicitly flagged ambiguity of 'tea' versus 'coffee' for page 4 blank 3 and corrected slide 10's misleading classification of 'olive' as uncountable (olive is countable; olive oil is uncountable). Both contain 20-minute preparation plans and user-customizable examples; not committed to english-kyna repo.
